description: This plot illustrates the relative change across different layer groups for four distinct configurations of token multipliers and bit precisions, alongside a reference baseline. The categorical x-axis represents layer groups, with discrete labels progressing sequentially through "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32". The linear y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" and ranges from -25% to 5%, with major tick marks spaced at 10% intervals (-25%, -15%, -5%, 5%). A horizontal grey dashed line runs constantly at the 0% mark across the entire x-axis. The solid yellow line with circular markers, representing "LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit", begins near 0% at Layer1-4, experiences a minor dip to approximately -1.5% at Layer13-20, and concludes slightly above 0% at Layer29-32. The solid red line with square markers, denoting "LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit", starts at 0% at Layer1-4, declines to a minimum of roughly -4.5% at Layer13-20, and recovers to near 0% at Layer29-32. The solid light blue line with circular markers, indicating "RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit", starts at approximately -1.5% at Layer1-4, drops to a notable low of about -12.5% at Layer13-20, and rises to end near -1% at Layer29-32. Finally, the solid dark blue line with square markers, representing "RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit", begins at roughly -3% at Layer1-4, exhibits a sharp decline to a minimum of -25% at Layer13-20, and ascends to finish at approximately -3% at Layer29-32.
